outcome.description: The call outcome. Must be exactly one of: Interested, Busy, Declined, Gatekeeper, Callback

call_status.description: The call status. Must be exactly one of: Spoke to Human, Voicemail, No Answer, Number Failed, AI Gatekeeper, Hung Up

has_seen_invite.description: Whether the prospect confirmed they saw the invitation email. Must be exactly one of: true, false, null. Use null if unknown or not discussed.

follow_up_action.description: The follow-up action requested. Must be exactly one of: resend, bump, none

callback_requested.description: Whether the prospect explicitly asked for a callback. true if yes, false otherwise.

callback_when.description: When the prospect wants to be called back. A specific time if given (e.g. 'Tuesday 3pm'), 'unspecified' if they asked for callback without a time, or empty string if no callback requested.

prospect_email_confirmed.description: The prospect's email address if they provided or confirmed one during the call. Empty string if not discussed or not provided.
